title: assistant opens the PDF viewer at a page (manual until automated)

clauses.text: Asked in the chat to open a PDF at a page, the assistant asks first and shows the file and page on the card; after you agree the viewer opens at that page.

steps.do: Ask the assistant: open a PDF you can read at page 3.
steps.expect: An approval card shows the file and page 3. After you agree, the PDF viewer opens on that file at page 3.

clauses.text: A page past the end is refused before the card appears.

steps.do: Ask the assistant to open the same file at a page past its last page.
steps.expect: The assistant says in words that the page does not exist. No card asks and the viewer does not open.

clauses.text: The request is for the person who asked only.

steps.do: Sign in as a second person (needs a second account) and check that no viewer opens from the first person's request.
steps.expect: The second person's screen shows no PDF viewer opened by that request.
